title: A calculation item does nothing to an expression that has no measure reference
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( SUM ( T[Qty] ), Adjust[Adjustment] = "Plus 2" ) )

source.quote: Without a measure reference, a calculation item does not apply any modification.
source.supports: SUM ( T[Qty] ) is not a measure reference, so Plus 2 is not applied
